title_zh: NEWS IN 10 每日新聞英語｜11 月 17 日

stories.headline_en: Taiwan Ranks 13th in Global Digital and AI Readiness
stories.headline_zh: 臺灣在全球數位與人工智慧準備度排名第 13

sentences.en: Taiwan ranked the 13th position in the 2026 World Digital and AI Ranking.
sentences.zh: 臺灣在 2026 年世界數位與人工智慧排名中位居第 13 名。

sentences.en: This global report evaluates economies' readiness for digital transformation.
sentences.zh: 這份全球報告評估了各經濟體對數位轉型的準備度。

sentences.en: The Swiss-based IMD institute created the comprehensive ranking.
sentences.zh: 這項全面的排名是由總部設於瑞士的 IMD 學院所編纂。

sentences.en: Taiwan showed strength in technology and efficiency, ranking high.
sentences.zh: 臺灣在科技和效率方面表現強勁，排名很高。

sentences.en: However, its performance in public leadership was notably weaker.
sentences.zh: 然而，臺灣在公共領導方面的表現顯著較弱。

stories.headline_en: AI Unlocks New Mathematical Discoveries from Gödel's Work
stories.headline_zh: 人工智慧從哥德爾著作中解鎖新的數學發現

sentences.en: Researchers in Helsinki used an AI model named Claude.
sentences.zh: 赫爾辛基的研究人員使用了一個人工智慧模型，名為 Claude。

sentences.en: It examined complex workbooks by mathematician Kurt Gödel.
sentences.zh: 它檢視了數學家庫爾特·哥德爾撰寫的複雜筆記本。

sentences.en: Humans struggled with these writings for many years.
sentences.zh: 人類多年來一直難以理解這些著作。

sentences.en: The AI completed this difficult task in just days.
sentences.zh: 這個人工智慧僅在數天內就完成了這項艱鉅的任務。

sentences.en: It found new mathematical theorems from his notes.
sentences.zh: 它從哥德爾的筆記中發現了新的數學定理。

stories.headline_en: Wall Street Falls Amid Concerns Over AI Development
stories.headline_zh: 華爾街因對人工智慧發展的擔憂而下跌

sentences.en: Wall Street stock markets closed lower yesterday.
sentences.zh: 華爾街股市昨日收盤走低。

sentences.en: Chip company shares faced significant selling pressure.
sentences.zh: 晶片公司股票面臨顯著的拋售壓力。

sentences.en: Concerns about rapid AI development affected investor confidence.
sentences.zh: 對人工智慧快速發展的擔憂影響了投資者信心。

sentences.en: Some industry leaders proposed a slower pace for AI progress.
sentences.zh: 一些產業領袖建議放慢人工智慧發展的步調。

sentences.en: Major indexes like the S&P 500 saw notable drops.
sentences.zh: 標準普爾 500 指數等主要指數出現顯著下跌。
